verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is a coding agent, and a team knowledge workspace is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no shared, team-level workspace built from docs and repos. GEMINI.md context files and --include-directories only give a local session per-project context and extra directories; that is adjacent functionality, not a shared source of truth for a team.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team
